title: competitor.comparison_requested
description: Compare a finished crawl of your site against finished crawls of competitors. Published by the gateway or the orchestrator; consumed by the competitor service, which fetches every report itself rather than receiving them here. Crawl ids, not domains: a competitor has to be crawled before it can be compared, and this service does not start crawls.

comparison_id.description: Allocated by the caller so the result url is known before the work starts.

competitor_crawl_ids.description: Bounded because every entry is a crawl report fetched over the network and held in memory while the comparison runs.
